 Save the Date for the Annual Trunk or Treat and Fall Festival at Southern Hills Church of Christ
 By Jen Haley - October 21, 2026 
 Join Southern Hills Church of Christ (2508 Goose Creek Byp, Franklin) on Saturday, October 24th from 4-8 PM for a FREE family-friendly event at the Trunk or Treat and Fall Festival!
 The event will feature a costume parade and prizes, games and fun, dinner, and more!
 Please register HERE .
